visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens in a studio lounge where a young woman in a pink long-sleeved dress sits on a sofa, holding papers and speaking with animated facial expressions. Three other individuals sit behind her on the couch—two women and one man—surrounded by recording equipment, soft lighting, and bubble tea cups on a low wooden table. (2) The camera cuts to a close-up of the woman in the pink dress in a vocal booth, wearing professional over-ear headphones and standing in front of a condenser microphone with a pop filter. She smiles and gestures towards her stomach while looking at a man adjusting the microphone stand. (3) The shot shifts back to the lounge area where the group is gathered around the table, watching a performance or playback. They are laughing and clapping, with variety-style text bubbles appearing around their heads. (4) The camera moves to a production desk where two men are seated, looking at a computer monitor displaying digital audio workstation (DAW) software with various audio waveforms. A person in the background walks past as the engineers point at the screen. (5) The final sequence returns to the group on the couch as they cheer and raise their hands in celebration, while the woman in the pink dress is later seen sitting alone on the couch, drinking from a red cup and speaking directly to the camera with a confused but smiling expression.
